text: わたし　オツキミやまに　キノコの　ポケモン　とりに　きたの！

structure.jp: キノコの　ポケモン　とりに

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb with ます cut off plus に, followed by a verb of coming or going, tells what you came to do. とりに　きた = 'came to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is the soft, girlish form of のだ, used when explaining yourself. きたの = 'I came, you see'.
